title: astragalus parviflorus
intro: Astragalus parviflorus, commonly known as Smallflower Milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, supporting immune function and potentially reducing stress and fatigue. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus parviflorus include modulating the immune system, exhibiting antiviral and antibacterial effects, and potentially reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus parviflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and isoflavones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
